newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen refraining from open market action.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen refraining from open market action.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is likely to refrain from open market action on Friday, economists said.
The seven-day fixed system RP's injected Thursday are perceived to be enough to carry the central bank through the weekend, analysts said.
However, an add-need of approximately $4 billion is estimated for the remainder of the current two-week maintenance period.

"We expect them to be back in Monday with an overnight system RP," said James Blumenthal, economist with MCM Moneywatch. "There'll be pressure on the funds rate because Monday is a quarterly tax date."
At 1030 EDT/1430 GMT, the federal funds rate was quoted at 5-3/16 percent, below the central bank's 5-1/4 percent target.
